rows.en:
Me, I'd say it looks like Shimizu's face when she was murdered.
Come on, let's get a closer look.{p}

...Just as I thought. It's exactly what I figured.
See, I've seen dozens of her self-portraits.
And I loved the self-portraits she painted.
The strange thing is, I never heard of her painting many portraits at school.
This was probably the first and last time she ever painted one outside her home.
So it's no wonder nobody noticed.
But you can't fool my eyes.{p}

...This painting, see, has been painted twice.
On this canvas, there's another picture hidden under her self-portrait.
The way it's laid on... the amount of paint...
That's not how she normally painted.
I bet she forced herself to paint the self-portrait to hide the real picture underneath.
It had nothing to do with the competition coming up or anything like that.
She painted this desperately, to hide something.{p}

What do you say, {a}?
Want to try scraping this painting?
We might get cursed.
But it might lay the truth bare in front of us.{p}What'll it be, {a}?
Leave it as it is
Try scraping off the paint

So you'll scrape it, huh.
Yeah, that's right. Even if we leave it like this, we're gonna die anyway.{p}

If we're gonna die either way, we'd better do everything we can.
All right, I'm scraping.{p}

...Look!
I knew it, there's something hidden underneath.
Come on, I'll scrape off some more.
I know what's painted here.
You know too, don't you?
There's no doubt about it.
She tried to seal this picture away so that guy wouldn't kill her.
That's it!
It's him!
The guy who was always hanging around her house was this man, no question.
The man who lives inside this painting!{p}

...You know, here's what I think.
I bet Shimizu was really lonely.
She must have wanted someone by her side all the time.
So she decided to create a man who'd stay with her forever.
Using the medium she was best at: painting.
I don't know what method she used, but anyway, I guess it worked.
Whether it was a ghost, a demon, or a delusion she created, I can't say.{p}

Still, she succeeded in calling up something nameless.
But that man did what she told him at first, and then gradually started defying her.
He got a will of his own, and started asserting it.
...And then tragedy struck.
When she tried to seal him inside the painting, he killed her.{p}
And even then, still trying to seal away the man in the painting, she must have come back as a ghost day after day, finishing the painting little by little.{p}

The four who died weren't cursed to death by her, but by the man in that painting.
Don't you think she was desperately trying to warn people about him, hoping someone would notice?
That the man in that painting existed, and how to get rid of him.
To stop that, he killed off the four guys who were close to learning the secret...
Don't you think so?
That's what I'd like to think.
Mind you, it's not like I actually know anything.
It's all just something I imagined.{p}

Anyway, I've wiped out the painting.
So there's no telling what happens from here.
Maybe, like the rumor says, we're going to be cursed to death by Shimizu sometime soon for seeing that painting.
But then again, now that the man's gone, maybe we don't have to worry about getting killed anymore.
Well, we'll know how it turns out soon enough.
Sometime soon.{p}

...Sometime soon.
Ha ha ha...{p}

Well then, let's head back to the newspaper club.
We've still gotta hear whoever's next.{p}

Figured as much.
Which means you're gonna die too.{p}

Don't get all sulky on me.
I saw it too, so we're in the same boat.{p}

...Heh, listen to you.
"I don't remember,"
you say?{p}You're seriously telling me you forgot already?
I really forgot
Actually, I remember

Huh, is that so.
Then there's nothing I can tell you.{p}

...No, wait, there is one thing.
Listen, you'd better take good care of your life while you can.
That rumor that anyone who sees the horrible face in that painting dies...
It's the real thing, you know.
With that, Shindo stood up.{p}

Looking angry, he walked off to the door.
What should I do? {f:He's going to leave|It looks like he's going home}.{p}{f:I|I}...
Let him go
Call him back

{f:I|I} watched Shindo leave.
What I'd forgotten, I'd forgotten{f:.|. I can't help that.}{p}
None of us felt like going on any longer, so in the end {f:we|we} just called it a day.{p}

When I got home to my room, {f:I|I} flopped down on my bed.
Honestly, thanks to Shindo, I'd botched the interview{f:.|.}
I'd have to get everyone together again sometime soon...
I was thinking about that when it happened.
{f:I|I} felt a strange gaze on me.
What {f:was it|could it be}?
{f:I|I} sat up and looked at the poster on the wall.
..........Our eyes met.{p}

It was the poster that was looking at {f:me|me}☆
No, it was no longer {f:my|my} poster.{p}

The face still looked straight ahead, but its eyes alone rolled to glare at me.
This face..........
{f:I|I} screamed.
This face, the one I'd just seen in the art room.
As {f:I|I} kept screaming in terror, the face pressed down on top of me.{p}

Everything went black before my eyes.
A lukewarm breath blew against my ear.{p}

"Come now... you're coming along too."
Was this the voice of the dead Shimizu{f:?|?}
At that instant, {f:my|my} arms rose.
They clamped down on my parched, bone-dry throat.
That's insane!
{f:My|My} arms were trying to strangle {f:me|me}★
I was slowly fading.
Giving {f:myself|myself} up to the swelling darkness, in the final moment I saw {f:my|my} own body, gone cold.{p}
Its face looked exactly like the Shimizu I'd seen in the art room..................{p}

"Shindo!"
{f:I|I} stood up.
"{f:Sorry about that|I'm so sorry}.
The truth is, I did see it. But I was scared..."{p}

Shindo turned around.
"It's fine, I get how you feel. So, mind if I go on with the story?
It's the other story about Tomoko Shimizu."
Of course, nobody was going to object.
When {f:we|we} nodded, Shindo sat back down in his seat.
All right, here goes.{p}

Thought so.
Once you've seen a face like that, there's no way you could ever forget it.{p}You really did see it, didn't you?
I saw it
I didn't see it

Shindo folded his arms as if to say the story was over, and looked around at {f:us|us}.
{f:I|I} was dumbfounded.
"That's... it?"
"You're not interested in Tomoko Shimizu's story, right?
I didn't bring any other stories."
He said it with a perfectly straight face.
But if the story about Shimizu was true, then Shindo, who said he'd seen that horrifying face too, had to be in danger{f:, didn't he?|, didn't he?}
"...Aren't you scared, Shindo?"{p}

When I asked that, he grinned.
"I'm the only one who won't die.
I was going to tell you why, but you said you didn't want to hear it."
The reason only Shindo wouldn't die★
"What the hell does that mean★"
Someone shouted.{p}

I caught up with Shindo as he walked down the hallway and put a hand on his shoulder.
Shindo turned around, annoyed.
"What? You've got no more business with me, right?"
"{f:It was my fault|It was my fault}. I apologize, so please come back to the club room and tell your story."
{f:I|I} bowed my head low.
But above {f:my|my} head, Shindo let out a little snort.{p}

"Too late. That's your punishment for throwing my kindness back in my face.
You're going to get Tomoko Shimizu's curse."
That was way too cruel!
{f:I|I} was apologizing with all my heart, and he was sneering at me like this.
The blood rushed to my head.
"Isn't that way too selfish★ As long as you're the only one who's saved, it's fine?!"{p}

"Shut up."
As he started to walk off, I frantically grabbed his arm.
"I said wait!"
"What the hell are you doing? Let go!"
Shindo shook his arm.
When he saw {f:I|I} still wouldn't let go, he {f:kicked his leg up at me|swung it around even harder}.{p}

"Ugh!"
{f:A brutal blow to my gut|His arm hit me}.
{f:I|I} couldn't take it and crumpled into a crouch.
"{f:That's what you get for being so damn persistent|Ah...}!"
{f:With that, Shindo started walking again, and I|Shindo} {f:glared at his back|looked flustered and started to walk away}.{p}

{f:Hatred|That one}{f: swelled up rapidly in my chest.| wasn't on purpose, I think.}
{f:As if driven by something,|But to just walk off}{f: I broke into a run.| without even apologizing...}{p}

The handle was slick with blood.
No way★
{f:I|I} peered into Shindo's face.
Smeared with the streams of blood running from his head, his half-open eyes didn't blink.
{f:I|I} had killed Shindo★
Everything around me started spinning, and {f:I|I} sank to the floor.{p}

It's actually the decorations in her room.
There were posters stuck up all over the walls of that room.
If they'd been idols or whatever, I'd have just thought, yeah, she's a girl after all...
But Shimizu's collection had no rhyme or reason at all.
Not just idols and anime, either. There were ones like some totally unknown enka singer, and pictures cut out of the calendars shops give away.
There was even an election poster, which surprised me. Who knows where she tore that one down from.
And the person on each one was always facing straight out.{p}

Thinking back now, I bet she always wanted someone to be watching her.
The whole time, from the moment she woke up in the morning until she went to bed at night.
Whenever I was in that room, my back always started crawling.
It was uncomfortable as hell, but she looked happy.
So I figured...{p}

maybe she picked a self-portrait for her entry in the prefectural competition because she wanted lots of people to see it.
But if that's so, why does that painting turn into a horrifying face?
Once a rumor about a curse gets started, nobody's going to want to look at it.
There's no way she could stand that.
And yet..........
Could it be she's got something she's trying to say?{p}What do you think?
That can't be it
I think she's got something she's trying to say

...Yeah, you're right.
I guess that's way too far-fetched.
...Sorry, but could you let me rest a little?
My head's getting all jumbled. I don't even know what I was trying to say anymore.
Maybe I can talk more later, but give me a break for now.
...No, wait, just one last thing.{p}

If Shimizu comes to see you, say, tonight... I'm just saying.
No matter what she looks like, could you try not to be scared of her?
I think that'd be a terrible insult to her.
I don't want you lumping her in with yokai and evil spirits.
I bet that's how the four who died got killed.
So, yeah.
And one more thing... if you can, would you tell her I've been wanting to see her?
Weird, huh?
She might be an evil spirit, and I still want to see her.
But.......... I'm counting on you.
That's it for my story, for now.
Who's up next?{p}
